item.title: Find old versions: ISC BIND: Data Processing Errors
item.description:
ISC BIND: Denial of service · pre-auth · internet-facing · exploited · fix: 9.9.7, 9.10.2

First step: This flaw dates from 2015, but CISA only now lists it as exploited. Find any system that still runs an affected version of ISC BIND, and update or retire it.

ISC BIND contains a data processing errors vulnerability that could allow remote attackers to cause a denial of service via TKEY queries.

High · Fix available · CVE-2015-5477
